note: Cover images for bey-model taxonomy leaves, fetched from beyblade.fandom.com via the MediaWiki API (prop=pageimages) and transcoded locally to bounded webp. Fandom TEXT is CC-BY-SA; these IMAGES are predominantly publisher product shots (Takara-Tomy / Hasbro) with no explicit grant from the uploader, so their use as catalogue imagery on a commercial site is an open licensing question. Recorded here so attribution is possible and removal is mechanical: delete public/images/beys, delete appkit/src/seed/_helpers/category-images-generated.ts, re-run the category seed.
